annotations.title: Save a clip as a template

description:
Use this when the user wants a clip's look kept to use again: "save this style", "clip my next streams like
this". Saves the clip's whole edit (layout, captions, color, effects, music, text, sounds) as a template.
Set for_new_clips only for "always" or "from now on" (ask if unclear); look_from saves a TikTok or YouTube
link's look as a clipping preset (Premium).
Not for: putting a saved style on a clip (style_clip with template). Free: no Horizon Units.

category.description: Group: hype, story, montage, podcast or another seen in edit_catalog.

clip_id.description: Clip id from list_clips. Empty when look_from is used.

for_new_clips.description: true also makes it the default clipping preset for new clips; only if the user said always.

look_from.description: https link to a clip whose captions and layout to copy.

name.description: Template name, up to 60 characters, e.g. "Gaming hype".

name: save_template
